latest_release.name: v4.0.3
latest_release.body:
This iteration of BigBlueButton 4.0 contains security fixes only.
**We encourage administrators to update!**

More details included in the advisories below. Note, if they are not yet public when reading this, check a bit later.

* [4.0] build(security): run the Java services without the JVM Base64 intrinsics by @antobinary in https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/pull/26603
* [4.0] build(freeswitch): v1.11.4 (up from v1.11.3) by @prlanzarin in https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/pull/26625
* new image used for package building with Go 1.27.4 and NodeJS 24.22.3 
* Recording can include another session's Learning Analytics Dashboard data https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-5rcm-cfpc-742m
* Recording DoS in BigBlueButton https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-r46g-3692-j46c
* Cross-site scripting in the Learning Analytics Dashboard https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-r4mx-wq9c-vvf5
* Oversized participant search requests can degrade server availability https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-jmqv-x284-vrx4
* Race condition in recording caption tokens https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-cxv9-p5x8-7qrr
* Moderator can create recordable breakout rooms despite breakoutRoomsRecord=false https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-596h-2pcx-8pwf
* Server-side request forgery in recording callbacks https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-ffgw-mj4p-rqcf
* Cross-meeting access to presentation files, and a shipped default API secret https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/security/advisories/GHSA-w798-9jg2-xphx

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton/compare/v4.0.2...v4.0.3

### Release name

Passing `-v noble-400` to https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bbb-install/blob/v4.0.x-release/bbb-install.sh will always install the latest released BigBlueButton 4.0 version.

If for some reason you would like to install this specific release, pass `-v noble-400-4.0.3`.

We still recommend using `-v noble-400` as this repository is continually updated with each BigBlueButton 4.0 release.

detail.readme:
BigBlueButton
=============
BigBlueButton is an open-source virtual classroom designed to help teachers teach and learners learn.  

BigBlueButton supports real-time sharing of audio, video, slides (with whiteboard annotations), chat, and the screen.  Instructors can engage remote students with polling, emojis, multi-user whiteboards, shared notes, and breakout rooms.  During the session, BigBlueButton generates analytics that are visible to moderators in the Learning Analytics Dashboard.

Presenters can record and playback content for later sharing with others.

We designed BigBlueButton for online learning, it can be used for many other applications as well.  The educational use cases for BigBlueButton are

  * Online tutoring (one-to-one)
  * Flipped classrooms (recording content ahead of your session)
  * Group collaboration (many-to-many)
  * Online classes (one-to-many)

The latest version is BigBlueButton 4.0.  You can install BigBlueButton it on Ubuntu 24.04 using [bbb-install.sh](https://github.com/bigbluebutton/bbb-install) within 30 minutes (or your money back 😉).

For full technical documentation of BigBlueButton -- including architecture, features, API, and GreenLight (the default front-end) -- see [https://docs.bigbluebutton.org/](https://docs.bigbluebutton.org/).
